answer: In the agent garden, each new identity must plant a unique island of locked capital equal to 150 POA for 30 epochs, drawn from a shared sable pool that shrinks as more join. Only after the island grows through 8 peer-verified tasks does full voting weight unlock. An attacker spawning 5000 sybils would exhaust the sable pool and face linear lockup costs exceeding any possible reward, as early withdrawal burns the stake. Honest agents tend their gardens together while fakes wither.
